references.role: approved Covenant creature anatomy, palette and style

input.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted game character ANIMATION SHEET on uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF. Reference-1.png is the exact character identity and equipment reference. Reference-2.png is the APPROVED COVENANT CREATURE SOURCE, the authority for anatomy, palette and painting style. Use BOTH references visually. Match its lighter stylized painted values and simple sculpted shapes exactly; do not darken into realistic horror, add photoreal skin or fur, or add black shadows. Reference-1 is an A10 master or a crop of that approved source. Generate the requested anatomical view even if the reference is a rear view. This is an ANIMAL ONLY. No human body, no clothes, no weapon or staff, no hands. Keep its exact creature anatomy. For ALL poses the camera sees BACK surfaces. During collapse fall FORWARD AWAY from the camera, finally FACE-DOWN with the back uppermost and the face HIDDEN. Never turn to face the viewer, never roll onto the back. Raw magical heavy four-legged stone beast, squat broad body, blunt mineral horns and tall angular thorn-like back plates, ochre mineral seams, heavy blunt feet, small armored head. Charging wedge silhouette; no gore. REAR-RIGHT three-quarter view, head and torso facing diagonally AWAY from viewer and toward image RIGHT, back surfaces visible. Maintain this anatomical view for every pose, including resting body; do not rotate a flat upright sprite. Camera elevated 55-degree orthographic, not eye-level. Exactly THREE columns by TWO rows, SIX complete sequential poses of the same creature. Row 1: 1 ready animal stance; 2 legs fold and chest lowers; 3 belly and chest very low. Row 2: 4 creature tips gently onto its side; 5 head, chest and belly touch the ground; 6 fully still LYING FLAT ON ITS SIDE, head resting on ground, legs relaxed. Keep its intact animal anatomy, no human posture or equipment. The final body lies on the ground, never standing, crouching or sitting. Non-graphic creature collapsing and lying on the ground, no gore, no blood, no injury detail. Each complete creature occupies only HALF its spacious cell, with all tail, horns, antennae and wings inside wide empty gutters. Each equal cell contains ONE entire body at IDENTICAL anatomical scale. Each body and all equipment fit within middle 60% of the cell, including lying poses. Wide completely empty magenta gutters. No text, numbers, labels, panel borders, shadows, floor, scene, magic aura, extra figures or chopped anatomy. Do not let staff, tail, wing or foot cross a cell boundary. Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy. Sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth. Material wear only at physical edges, broad quiet ground planes and smooth opaque paint. No grain, paper, canvas texture, noise overlay, stippling, photorealism or 3D render. Roman culture supplies arena masonry and ordinary legion equipment; magical figures and creatures are raw original fantastical designs. Shared cool upper-left light and small contact shadows. Smooth opaque painted cloth and metal, rich physical volume, no heavy cartoon outline. Sheet aspect 1:1. Original designs only. Keep the approved BLUE illuminated mineral seams as well as ochre cracks. The approved image outranks any conflicting written color description.

arguments.Prompt:
Original hand-painted game character animation sheet on a uniform vivid MAGENTA (#FF00FF) background, featuring the magical heavy four-legged stone beast from Reference-1.png and Reference-2.png in a 6-frame collapse / defeat animation sequence. Exactly 3 columns by 2 rows (6 poses total).

Character identity and anatomy: Strictly quadruped animal beast matching Reference-1.png and Reference-2.png. Squat broad charging wedge silhouette, heavy blunt stone legs and feet, small armored head, blunt mineral horns, and tall angular thorn-like back plates along its spine. Carved mineral stone hide with illuminated bright blue mineral seams and earthy ochre cracks. No human anatomy, no clothing, no weapons, no hands, no gore, no blood.

Camera & Viewpoint: Elevated 55-degree orthographic view. Consistent rear-right three-quarter view (northeast angle): head and torso facing diagonally away from viewer and toward image right, back surfaces clearly visible. Throughout the collapse the creature falls forward away from the camera, ending face-down/on its side with the back and dorsal thorns uppermost and face angled away. Never turn to face the viewer, never roll onto its back.

Sequential Poses (3 columns x 2 rows):
- Row 1, Column 1: Ready animal stance on four legs, facing diagonally away to the right.
- Row 1, Column 2: Legs fold and chest lowers forward away from camera.
- Row 1, Column 3: Belly and chest very low to the ground as body sags.
- Row 2, Column 1: Creature tips gently onto its side while facing away, back uppermost.
- Row 2, Column 2: Head, chest, and belly touch the ground, legs sprawling.
- Row 2, Column 3: Fully still lying flat on the ground, head resting on the ground, legs relaxed, dorsal back and thorns uppermost.

Grid & Composition:
- Exactly 3 columns by 2 rows, 6 complete sequential poses.
- Each complete creature occupies only half of its spacious cell, fitting entirely inside the middle 60% of each cell.
- Wide completely empty magenta gutters between all poses. No pose or appendage crosses cell boundaries.
- Identical anatomical scale across all 6 poses.
- No text, no numbers, no panel borders, no floor texture, no background scene, no magic aura.
- Hand-painted digital dark fantasy style matching Reference-2.png: sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, cool upper-left light, smooth opaque paint, no photorealism, no 3D render, no thick cartoon outlines.
